build_Trainer: build a Trainer instance with FairseqConfig, task, model, and criterion for distributed data parallel training
train_step_Trainer: run a train_step on the Trainer to do forward, backward, and parameter update on sample batches
valid_step_Trainer: run a valid_step on the Trainer to do a forward pass in evaluation mode on a sample
save_checkpoint_Trainer: save a checkpoint with all training state including model, optimizer, and criterion to a file
load_checkpoint_Trainer: load a checkpoint from a file to restore model, optimizer, and training state for resuming training
